jobs.diagnosis: Installation request escaped its repository scope

Added a GitHub Actions workflow that runs the required npm checks (test, lint, build) on Node.js 22 for the repository root. The workflow uses actions/checkout and actions/setup-node, installs dependencies with npm ci, and executes the three checks in sequence. This satisfies the coverage gap that required these checks to be run on Node 22.

jobs.diff:
--- a/.github/workflows/patchgoblin.yml
+++ b/.github/workflows/patchgoblin.yml
@@ -0,0 +1,28 @@
+name: PatchGoblin CI
+on:
+  push: {}
+  pull_request: {}
+permissions:
+  contents: read
+jobs:
+  pg_2629410778:
+    name: . · node
+    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
+    timeout-minutes: 10
+    steps:
+    - uses: actions/checkout@v4
+      with:
+        persist-credentials: false
+    - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
+      with:
+        node-version: '22'
+        cache: npm
+        cache-dependency-path: package-lock.json
+    - name: Install dependencies
+      run: npm ci
+    - name: npm run test
+      run: npm run test
+    - name: npm run lint
+      run: npm run lint
+    - name: npm run build
+      run: npm run build
